definition: ECML PKDD, the European Conference on Machine Learning Principles and Practice of Knowledge Discovery in Databases, is one of the leading academic conferences on machine learning and knowledge discovery, held in Europe every year.
details: ECML PKDD, the European Conference on Machine Learning Principles and Practice of Knowledge Discovery in Databases, is one of the leading academic conferences on machine learning and knowledge discovery, held in Europe every year.

explainer.lead: ECML PKDD is an annual European academic conference where machine learning and knowledge discovery research takes centre stage. It matters because it provides a recurring meeting place for researchers working on how computers learn and discover useful knowledge.

tiers.eli5: ECML PKDD is like a yearly science fair in Europe for people who teach computers to learn from information. Researchers gather to share their work on learning and discovering useful patterns.
tiers.practitioner: For an engineer, ECML PKDD is a research conference to follow, not a software tool or library. Its focus is academic work in machine learning and knowledge discovery, with the conference held in Europe each year.
tiers.paperLevel: ECML PKDD denotes the European Conference on Machine Learning Principles and Practice of Knowledge Discovery in Databases. It is an annual academic conference held in Europe, covering machine learning and knowledge discovery.

explainer.example: A researcher studying machine learning attends the annual conference in Europe to engage with academic work in both machine learning and knowledge discovery.

usedIn.name: Machine learning research
usedIn.detail: A central subject area of the conference.

usedIn.name: Knowledge discovery research
usedIn.detail: The conference's other named area of academic focus.

explainer.outcome: The result is a recurring European forum for academic work on machine learning and knowledge discovery.
explainer.whyItMatters: ECML PKDD brings two closely connected research areas together at one leading annual conference. Its regular European setting gives their academic communities a shared place to meet.
